instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Haidar Akab Alwan
subject: 02_English_Language
topic: Narrative Tenses: The Six Past Forms

questions.question: John cooked, his guests had a good time, they left at midnight. Why the past simple?
questions.explanation: The past simple lists finished events in the order they happened.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي البسيط يسرد أحداثاً منتهية بترتيب حدوثها.

questions.question: Just after midnight, John was looking at the mess. Why the past continuous?
questions.explanation: The past continuous frames an activity that was already running at that past moment.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي المستمر يؤطّر نشاطاً كان جارياً في تلك اللحظة الماضية.

questions.question: His guests had just left. What does the past perfect show?
options: it was still in full progress
options_en: it was still in full progress
questions.explanation: The past perfect places the action before the past moment being described.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي التام يضع الفعل قبل اللحظة الماضية التي تُوصف.

questions.question: He had been acting suspiciously for days. Which form is this?
questions.explanation: Had been plus the -ing form is the past perfect continuous, an activity before a past point.
questions.explanation_ar: had been مع صيغة ing هي الماضي التام المستمر، نشاط قبل نقطة ماضية.

questions.question: A man was arrested. Which form is this?
questions.explanation: Was plus the past participle is the past simple passive of a finished event.
questions.explanation_ar: was مع اسم المفعول هي الماضي البسيط للمجهول لحدث منتهٍ.

questions.question: The house had been burgled. Which form is this?
questions.explanation: Had been plus the past participle is the past perfect passive of an earlier event.
questions.explanation_ar: had been مع اسم المفعول هي الماضي التام للمجهول لحدث أسبق.

questions.question: With after and before, which tense is often optional?
questions.explanation: After and before already show the order, so the past simple can replace the past perfect.
questions.explanation_ar: after و before توضحان الترتيب أصلاً، فيمكن للماضي البسيط أن يحل محل الماضي التام.

questions.question: When Alice arrived, I was making a cake. This means...
options: I had not started it yet
I make it every single day
I was in the middle of it
options_en: I had not started it yet
I make it every single day
I was in the middle of it
questions.explanation: The past continuous shows the activity was still under way at the moment of arrival.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي المستمر يدل على أن النشاط كان ما زال جارياً لحظة الوصول.

questions.question: I had made the cake by the time she came. This tells us...
options: I was still making it then
I had not begun it yet
I will make it much later
options_en: I was still making it then
I had not begun it yet
I will make it much later
questions.explanation: The past perfect shows the cake was complete before she arrived.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي التام يدل على أن الكعكة كانت جاهزة قبل وصولها.

questions.question: The film had started when we got to the cinema. This means...
questions.explanation: The past perfect places the start before our arrival, so the opening was missed.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي التام يضع البداية قبل وصولنا، أي أننا فوّتنا الافتتاح.

questions.question: When I got to the garage, my car was being repaired. This means...
options: the car was for sale then
options_en: the car was for sale then
questions.explanation: Was being plus the past participle is a passive action still running at that moment.
questions.explanation_ar: was being مع اسم المفعول فعل مبني للمجهول كان جارياً في تلك اللحظة.

questions.question: He was sacked because he had been stealing for years. The continuous shows...
options: a plan for the far future
options_en: a plan for the far future
questions.explanation: The continuous form presents repeated theft as an ongoing activity before the dismissal.
questions.explanation_ar: الصيغة المستمرة تعرض السرقة المتكررة كنشاط مستمر قبل الطرد.
